title: A Vehicle Still in the Workshop and the Share of a Payment Released
content:
Where a vehicle protected by the Keyturn Host Protection Plan is kept under a Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan, whether the workshop has had it in the last month decides the share of a payment released.

- Where the vehicle carries an active care plan and a workshop visit stands on it in the month before, the payment is released at the marketplace's open-repair share of 95 percent, the vehicle being still in the shop.
- Where the vehicle carries an active care plan and no workshop visit stands in that month, it is released at the marketplace's closed-repair share of 98 percent.
- Where the vehicle carries no active care plan, no share is taken on that account.

### The three readings side by side

| Care plan on the vehicle | Workshop visit in the month before | Released at |
|---|---|---|
| Active | one or more | 95 percent |
| Active | none | 98 percent |
| Not active, or none held | — | the whole of it |

A vehicle with no active care plan has nothing taken on that account whether or not a workshop has had it.

### The record consulted

The standing of the care plan and the workshop visits on the vehicle are read from the Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan held on that vehicle, counting visits within the month before.
